scope: Skills listed by the directory; this is not a complete inventory of every file in the repository.

skills.name: gstack-openclaw-ceo-review
skills.description: Use when asked to review a plan, challenge a proposal, run a CEO review, poke holes in an approach, think bigger about scope, or decide whether to expand or reduce the plan.

skills.name: gstack-openclaw-investigate
skills.description: Use when asked to debug, fix a bug, investigate an error, or do root cause analysis, and when users report errors, stack traces, unexpected behavior, or say something stopped working.

skills.name: gstack-openclaw-office-hours
skills.description: Use when asked to brainstorm, evaluate whether an idea is worth building, run office hours, or think through a new product idea or design direction before any code is written.

skills.name: gstack-openclaw-retro
skills.description: Weekly engineering retrospective. Analyzes commit history, work patterns, and code quality metrics with persistent history and trend tracking. Team-aware with per-person contributions, praise, and growth areas. Use when asked for weekly retro, what shipped this week, or engineering retrospective.

skills.name: browse
skills.description: Drive a real browser through Aside: open a page, read it, click through a flow, take screenshots, check console errors. (gstack)

skills.name: careful
skills.description: Safety guardrails for destructive commands. (gstack)

skills.name: cso
skills.description: Security audit: supported static findings; qualified profiles add reproduction and repair candidates. (gstack)

skills.name: deslop-shared-libs
skills.description: Find worthwhile shared-code extractions in recent work. (gstack)

skills.name: diagram
skills.description: Turn an English description (or mermaid source) into a diagram triplet: the source, an editable .excalidraw file you can open on excalidraw.com, and rendered SVG + PNG. (gstack)

skills.name: freeze
skills.description: Restrict file edits to a specific directory for the session. (gstack)

skills.name: gstack
skills.description: Install and use gstack in Capy and Claude Code. Load at session start to check this machine, and for gstack planning, code review, debugging, QA, design, security, documentation, and shipping workflows.

skills.name: guard
skills.description: Full safety mode: destructive command warnings + directory-scoped edits. (gstack)

skills.name: ios-clean
skills.description: Remove the DebugBridge SPM package and all #if DEBUG wiring from an iOS app. (gstack)

skills.name: ios-design-review
skills.description: Visual design audit for iOS apps on real hardware. (gstack)

skills.name: ios-sync
skills.description: Regenerate the iOS debug bridge against the latest upstream gstack templates. (gstack)

skills.name: landing-report
skills.description: Read-only queue dashboard for workspace-aware ship. (gstack)

skills.name: make-pdf
skills.description: Turn any markdown file into a publication-quality PDF. (gstack)

skills.name: open-gstack-browser
skills.description: Launch GStack Browser — AI-controlled Chromium with the sidebar extension baked in.

skills.name: setup-browser-cookies
skills.description: Import cookies from your real Chromium browser into the headless browse session. (gstack)

skills.name: test-audit
skills.description: Find low-value or duplicate tests and the test-only code they keep alive. (gstack)

skills.name: unfreeze
skills.description: Clear the freeze boundary set by /freeze, allowing edits to all directories again. (gstack)
